FAQ

Choose the right way to use SandBase.

Setup puts tools inside your AI app. APIs let your product call one tool directly. Build Agent is for reusable, multi-step work.

Who is SandBase for?+

SandBase is for builders who need working AI capabilities quickly, and FDEs who need to turn customer requirements into reusable Agent workflows.

Should I start with Setup, APIs, or Build Agent?+

Use Setup when you want tools inside Codex, Claude, Cursor, or Kiro. Use APIs when your product needs one tool, like search or image generation. Use Build Agent when the job has multiple steps and should be reused.

What is in the Store?+

The Store is where you find reusable Agent capabilities: Models, APIs, ready-made Agents, and Skills. You can test them, copy them, install them into Setup, or clone them into Build Agent.

What is an Agent workflow?+

An Agent workflow is a reusable job with instructions and tools. It can research a customer, enrich leads, monitor competitors, triage GitHub issues, or run another repeatable process.

What happens after I build an Agent?+

You can test it, publish it so apps and AI tools can call it, or schedule it to run automatically. Every execution becomes a Run with input, output, trace, and status.

What are Webhooks for?+

Webhooks notify your system when async model, API, or Agent work finishes or fails. They are delivery notifications, not tools inside the Agent.
